tag.editorial.heading: Architecture & Verification Guide
about.methodologyIntro: Every tool listed in our directory undergoes rigorous browser-based inspection before approval. We test each tool across multiple operating systems and browsers with active DevTools network inspection.
about.methodologyPoint1: Zero-Gate Verification: We verify that the core task completes end-to-end without login, signup, credit card entry, or email collection prompts.
about.methodologyPoint2: DevTools Network Audit: We inspect HTTP request headers and payloads to verify whether data is processed locally (client-side via WebAssembly/Canvas) or transferred to a backend server.
about.methodologyPoint3: Tracker & Telemetry Audit: We audit the DOM and network traffic for third-party analytics (Google Analytics, Meta Pixel, Hotjar) and browser fingerprinting scripts.
about.methodologyPoint4: Automated Health Checks: Once approved, tools are monitored every 6 hours by automated workers. If a tool goes offline, we automatically link to its latest working snapshot on web.archive.org.

extension.install.title: Quick Installation Guide
extension.install.chrome.step1: Download the extension zip file using the button above and extract it.
extension.install.chrome.step2: Navigate to chrome://extensions (or brave://extensions) in your browser.
extension.install.chrome.step3: Enable "Developer mode" in the top-right corner.
extension.install.chrome.step4: Click "Load unpacked" and select the extracted extension folder.
extension.install.firefox.step1: Download and extract the extension zip file.
extension.install.firefox.step2: Navigate to about:debugging#/runtime/this-firefox in your browser.
extension.install.firefox.step3: Click "Load Temporary Add-on" and select manifest.json inside the extracted folder.
